grades.reason: Describes the LoongArch FCSR0 Flags field (RW), which accumulates VZOUI exception status until software clears it. It also covers the Cause field and the FCSR2 alias, and says writes to an alias change only the matching fields. This answers how flags are recorded and cleared.
Covers the RISC-V Control Transfer Records freeze behavior. It has nothing to do with floating-point exception flags.

Describes moves between a general register and a condition flag register. These condition flags are not floating-point exception flags, and the passage says nothing about recording or clearing exception status.
Describes the FCLASS.S classify instruction. It only notes that the instruction does not set exception flags, and does not explain how flags are recorded or cleared.
